name: tpl-existence-1-goal
task: Pick up the key, then reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the hard Existence(at_goal) with the hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) is the Existence-of-last-step plus chain pattern for 'pick up the key, then reach the goal'. The chain forces has_key before the goal, so no separate Existence(has_key) is needed, and the clauses trace to the task.

texts: Reach the goal tile at some point during the episode.
Pick up the key (carry it) before the agent reaches the goal, so the key is acquired first and the goal is reached after it.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u3
(u1, at_goal) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_goal, u3) -> 11
